footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Strategy: includes a $1.7B income tax benefit; after $381M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 3.0% to $477M in 2025. Gross margin was 68.7%, versus 72.1% a year earlier, and the operating loss widened to $5.4B from $1.9B.
The net loss widened to $4.2B, or −$15.23 per share, from $1.2B. Operating cash flow was −$67.2M and free cash flow −$75.5M, versus −$56.0M.
sources: Strategy Inc Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
